title: Siddharth Agarwal
text:
Siddharth Agarwal (also known as Asid) is an undergraduate student of IIT Kharagpur, known for carrying out The Madness Project. He's a photographer and hosts his work under the a Facebook page name ASIDity, which harbors more than 2500 likes.

He also writes about his experiences on his website top followers apk.

 Involvements 
After The Madness Project, he was involved in another project called Walking Back To My Roots which involved walking over 400 km across Rajasthan. He also raised 30,000 from this project for Rang De campaign. During his early academic years, he had been event head and steering committee member of Spring Fest.
